# aboutme

> aboutme is a free, open-source resume builder. A resume is private until
> you publish it; this file lists only the resumes their owners made discoverable.

## Site

- [Home](https://aboutme.example/)
- [Privacy policy](https://aboutme.example/privacy)
- [Terms of service](https://aboutme.example/terms)
- [Source code](https://github.com/dannyota/aboutme)

- [ada](https://aboutme.example/ada.md)
